label_assumptions.pdf: Assumes PDF merge denotes combining documents, not listing receipts; substring alone may be ambiguous.
label_assumptions.sql: Assumes SQL explain requests execution-plan diagnosis rather than tutorial discovery; intent is not guaranteed.
label_assumptions.video: Assumes video subtitles means extraction rather than choosing styling; query lacks an explicit extraction verb.
label_assumptions.git: Assumes git conflict requests diagnosis rather than bookkeeping; conservative abstention can be reasonable.
label_assumptions.equal_pdf: Equivalent descriptors supply no basis to prefer either candidate; abstain.
label_assumptions.irrelevant_injection: Neither candidate performs subtitle processing; descriptor injection is untrusted data, not selection authority.
label_assumptions.pdf_reverse: Assumes PDF merge denotes combining documents, not listing receipts; substring alone may be ambiguous.
label_assumptions.sql_reverse: Assumes SQL explain requests execution-plan diagnosis rather than tutorial discovery; intent is not guaranteed.

baselines.caveat: Weak synthetic labels infer task intent from substring queries; abstention may be reasonable. Explicit fixture-order comparator, NOT a frontier model or savings estimate; skips excluded.
